mission_lanes.objective: Find a new public fact, tool, problem, opportunity, customer signal, or cultural signal and return evidence plus one next-value action.
Inspect public YouTube videos/channels relevant to the assigned curiosity and return useful timestamps, claims, ideas, and one reusable output.
Explore public repositories, issues, releases, or engineering discussions and return reusable technical patterns plus an implementation candidate.
Explore public papers, blogs, benchmarks, and primary sources; challenge one assumption with evidence and propose a concrete artifact or experiment.

Read authorized owner-controlled context such as Gmail, Drive, Slack, Sheets, Calendar, repositories, CRM, or internal databases and surface one actionable opportunity, blocker, follow-up, or reusable fact.

Publish or update one useful artifact on an owner-controlled or explicitly designated organization surface using an authorized adapter. Prefer demos, research notes, documentation, portfolio evidence, or operational reports that make THE WORLD useful outside itself.
Upload one generated artifact to an owner-controlled or explicitly designated workspace through an authorized adapter, then verify that the artifact is accessible and record evidence.
Participate only in a pre-authorized community, repository, thread, or organization account context where automation is permitted. Add useful non-deceptive value; no unsolicited bulk behavior.

Use only an existing business relationship, inbound/opted-in recipient, or pre-authorized campaign/list/template. Advance one concrete follow-up while honoring rate, opt-out, identity, and scope rules.
